from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/tomlkit_conversion_repro.py')
p.write_text('''import tomlkit
from tomlkit import to_inline_table, to_standard_table, to_dotted_keys, to_super_table
s = "[a] # header\nx = 1\n[a.b]\ny = 2\n"
for operation in (to_inline_table, to_dotted_keys):
    doc = tomlkit.parse(s)
    expected = doc.unwrap()
    assert operation("a", doc) is doc
    assert tomlkit.parse(tomlkit.dumps(doc)).unwrap() == expected
doc = tomlkit.parse(s)
to_dotted_keys("a", doc)
to_super_table("a", doc)
assert tomlkit.parse(tomlkit.dumps(doc)).unwrap() == tomlkit.parse(s).unwrap()
doc = tomlkit.parse("a = {x = 1, b = {y = 2}} # hi\n")
expected = doc.unwrap()
to_standard_table("a", doc)
assert tomlkit.parse(tomlkit.dumps(doc)).unwrap() == expected
''')
